# Muhammad Dairy

> Family dairy in Okara, Punjab, Pakistan, making pure desi ghee from fresh cream since 1975. Khalis doodh and dahi are supplied daily in Okara; desi ghee is couriered anywhere in Pakistan.

Muhammad Dairy is a family-run dairy on GT Road, Sheikh Basti, opposite Azhar Residences, Okara. It has made khalis (pure) desi ghee the traditional way since 1975: fresh cream is churned into makhan, then slow-cooked into golden ghee with nothing added — no vegetable oil, banaspati, colour or flavouring.

## Products
- Desi Ghee (1 kg, 2.5 kg, 5 kg) — couriered anywhere in Pakistan
- Fresh Makhan (hand-churned white butter) — Okara only
- Khalis Doodh (milk) — daily supply in Okara city, and bulk for weddings/hotels
- Khalis Dahi (yogurt) — daily supply in Okara city, and bulk for weddings/hotels

## Ordering
- Order on WhatsApp: +92 305 684 7007 (local: 0305 684 7007)
- Okara: cash on delivery. Other cities in Pakistan: desi ghee couriered, paid by bank transfer or mobile wallet.
- Every order is confirmed personally.

## Service area
- Desi ghee: all of Pakistan (by courier).
- Milk, dahi, makhan: Okara city only (perishable).
